findings.reason: the declared graph is what a re-dispatch and a reader order on, and §26's cost figure is only valid once §24 and §25 have landed, so the plan should declare `s25: [s24]` and `s26: [s24, s25]` as `s19`/`s21` already declare their §18 wait.
findings.text: `plan-section-depends-on` has no entry for `s25` or `s26`, yet §25's Why is the cost that appeared after §24 landed (plan.html:156) and §26's Why is the cost that appeared with "§24 and §25 live", measured after both (plan.html:163); §26 also edits `review_records._build_store_entries`/`_revalidated_entries`, the store-selection path §24 rewrote, so an undeclared edge leaves the declared graph orderable against its own evidence

rubric_items.done_when: pass — §22 and §23 (plan.html:141, :145) each name a measurable count, a base-revision comparison and a declared negative control that must turn the case red; the comments added by this unit report those counts and, for §23, the parity probe over 232 plans and 11 shapes.
rubric_items.evidence_paths: pass — the fragment files the sections' write paths name exist on durable paths (`docs/evidence/fragments/a-read-costs-what-changed/read-costs-referenced-plan-once-s22.html`, `read-costs-no-second-parse-s23.html`), and §25/§26's arm logs resolve under `~/.cache/reckon-classify-tick-scope/` and `~/.cache/reckon-refresh-store-scope/` (`arm-base.log`, `arm-head.log` in each), not a scratchpad.
rubric_items.naming: pass — the added comment text carries no plan labels into code paths or the evidence filenames; the sprint label appears only in prose about plan state.
rubric_items.reasoning: pass — §22's 86.1% cumulative share is stated with its own stat-wrapper caveat (29.6% of leaf samples); §23's Why states the 47.0% and 86.0% shares are nested rather than additive and sizes its own residual at 83 of 6,078 samples (1.4%), which reconciles with the cited 2,854 and 2,665 sample totals; the §23 landing comment's "0 mismatches" is the pass at the repaired head `69bdb4c082`, and the run's manifest records the divergence the earlier review found as fixed there (read from the run's own manifest §9 / rubric.evidence), so the two comments that touch the parity figure do not contradict each other.
rubric_items.single_goal: pass — §22 (ref reads), §23 (second parse) and the three newly-done sections each name one deliverable.
rubric_items.wiring: a finding — `plan-section-depends-on` (plan.html:23) declares no edge for the newly-declared `s25` or `s26`, though §25's Why opens "With §24 landed and the station reloaded onto it" (plan.html:156) and §26's Why opens "With §24 and §25 live" and attributes its cost from a profile taken under both (plan.html:163).
